The implementation is complete. All three functions in `airflow/www/utils.py` now:

- **Return `markupsafe.Markup`** instead of plain strings, so Jinja2 renders them as HTML.
- **URL-encode special characters** in IDs within the `href` (handled by `url_for`, e.g. `<`→`%3C`), while `Markup.format()` HTML-escapes the interpolated display text — so no raw angle brackets or ampersands leak from ID values.

I removed the now-redundant explicit `escape()` calls since `Markup.format()` auto-escapes interpolated arguments, avoiding double-encoding.
